# Error codes

Every refusal prints `{"state": "rejected", "reason": "<code>"}`, and receipts and execution results name failures with the same codes. Each entry says what caused it, what to do next and whether re-running the same command unchanged can succeed (**retry-safe**). The same entries are available offline:

```sh
piceli explain <code>          # human text
piceli explain <code> --json   # the structured entry
```

Codes never contain paths, secret values or server messages. See {doc}`../agents` for how an agent should react to them.

## Command-line contract (any command)

(error-invalid-or-unavailable-artifact-input)=
### `invalid-or-unavailable-artifact-input`

**Invalid or unavailable artifact input.** An `artifacts` command could not read or validate one of its inputs (a plan, layout, spec or source file). The detail is withheld because it could contain private paths.

- **Fix:** Check that every path passed to the command exists, is readable and holds the documented format; run the matching `preview` command first.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-unknown-error-code)=
### `unknown-error-code`

**Unknown error code.** `piceli explain` was given a code that is not in the registry.

- **Fix:** Check the spelling; `piceli help-json` and docs/reference/errors.md list every code.
- **Retry-safe:** no


## Artifact delivery inputs (`piceli artifacts deliver`)

(error-credentials-file-not-private)=
### `credentials-file-not-private`

**Credentials file is readable by others.** The registry credentials file grants permissions to group or others.

- **Fix:** Run `chmod 600` on the credentials file.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-docker-socket-required)=
### `docker-socket-required`

**Local Docker socket required.** The Docker endpoint is not an absolute `unix://` socket (TCP and SSH endpoints are refused).

- **Fix:** Pass `--docker-socket /absolute/path/docker.sock` or point `DOCKER_HOST` at a unix socket.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-docker-tool-required)=
### `docker-tool-required`

**docker CLI required.** The delivery needs the docker CLI and none was found or it is not executable.

- **Fix:** Install docker or pass `--docker PATH` (and `--docker-sha256` to pin it).
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-forward-options-incomplete)=
### `forward-options-incomplete`

**Port-forward options incomplete.** `--via-forward` needs an explicit `--kubeconfig` (absolute) and `--namespace`.

- **Fix:** Add `--kubeconfig PATH --namespace NAME`; Piceli never uses an ambient kube context.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-forward-options-without-forward)=
### `forward-options-without-forward`

**Port-forward options without --via-forward.** `--namespace`, `--kubeconfig`, `--context` or `--kubectl*` were given without `--via-forward`.

- **Fix:** Add `--via-forward deployment/NAME` or remove those options.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-forward-target-not-loopback)=
### `forward-target-not-loopback`

**Forwarded target is not loopback.** With `--via-forward`, the `oci://` target must be a loopback address with an explicit port.

- **Fix:** Use `--to oci://127.0.0.1:PORT/repository`.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-grant-mismatch)=
### `grant-mismatch`

**Delivery grant mismatch.** The delivery grant does not name this exact target, or it expired before the delivery started.

- **Fix:** Run the delivery again (a fresh grant is created per run); raise `--timeout` if it expired.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-invalid-approved-digest)=
### `invalid-approved-digest`

**Invalid approved digest.** `--approve-digest` is not `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex characters.

- **Fix:** Pass the image config digest, e.g. from `docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}'`.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-ca-file)=
### `invalid-ca-file`

**Invalid CA file.** `--ca-file` is not a readable PEM file.

- **Fix:** Pass the registry's CA certificate bundle as a PEM file.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-credentials-file)=
### `invalid-credentials-file`

**Invalid registry credentials file.** `--credentials` is not a small regular JSON file holding `{"username": …, "password": …}` or `{"token": …}`.

- **Fix:** Write the credentials file in one of the documented shapes.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-delivery-input)=
### `invalid-delivery-input`

**Invalid delivery input.** The delivery could not be set up or failed on an input it could not validate (the detail is withheld because it could contain private paths).

- **Fix:** Re-check every delivery option; run with the same inputs against a local target first to isolate the problem.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-forward)=
### `invalid-forward`

**Invalid port-forward settings.** A `--via-forward` setting (namespace, target, remote port or context) is invalid.

- **Fix:** Pass `--via-forward deployment/NAME` with a valid `--namespace`, `--forward-remote-port` and optional `--context`.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-node-registry)=
### `invalid-node-registry`

**Invalid node registry address.** `--node-registry` is not `host[:port]`.

- **Fix:** Pass the address the node pulls from, e.g. `127.0.0.1:5000`.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-reference)=
### `invalid-reference`

**Invalid image reference.** `--ref` is not a tagged image name (digests and option-like values are refused).

- **Fix:** Pass a tagged name such as `my-app:1.0`.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-source)=
### `invalid-source`

**Invalid delivery source.** `--image` is not a valid local image reference, or `--archive` is not a usable file.

- **Fix:** Pass exactly one of `--image NAME[:TAG]` or `--archive PATH` (an OCI or docker-save tar).
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-ssh-agent-socket)=
### `invalid-ssh-agent-socket`

**Invalid ssh-agent socket.** `--ssh-agent-socket` is not an absolute path.

- **Fix:** Pass the absolute path of the agent socket (`$SSH_AUTH_SOCK`).
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-target)=
### `invalid-target`

**Invalid delivery target.** `--to` is not a supported target (`oci://host[:port]/repo[:tag]`, `ssh://user@host`, `docker://container`), or the grant for it could not be built.

- **Fix:** Fix `--to`; see docs/node_delivery.md for the accepted forms.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-timeout)=
### `invalid-timeout`

**Invalid timeout.** `--timeout` is not a positive number within the allowed bounds.

- **Fix:** Pass a positive number of seconds.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-kubectl-tool-required)=
### `kubectl-tool-required`

**kubectl CLI required.** `--via-forward` needs kubectl and none was found or it is not executable.

- **Fix:** Install kubectl or pass `--kubectl PATH` (and `--kubectl-sha256` to pin it).
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-node-options-on-registry-target)=
### `node-options-on-registry-target`

**Node options on a registry target.** `--ref`, `--ssh*` or `--ssh-agent-socket` were given with an `oci://` target.

- **Fix:** Remove the node-import options, or deliver to an `ssh://` / `docker://` target.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-node-registry-required)=
### `node-registry-required`

**Node registry address required.** A delivery through `--via-forward` cannot derive the address nodes pull from.

- **Fix:** Add `--node-registry host[:port]` (the address as seen from the node).
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-plain-http-not-loopback)=
### `plain-http-not-loopback`

**Plain HTTP to a non-loopback registry.** The registry target asks for plain HTTP but its host is not a loopback address.

- **Fix:** Use TLS for remote registries, or reach the registry through `--via-forward`.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-reference-required)=
### `reference-required`

**Image reference required.** The archive has no single image name, so the node cannot name the import.

- **Fix:** Add `--ref my-app:TAG`.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-registry-options-on-node-target)=
### `registry-options-on-node-target`

**Registry options on a node target.** Registry or forward options were given with an `ssh://` or `docker://` target.

- **Fix:** Remove the registry options, or deliver to an `oci://` target.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-ssh-tool-required)=
### `ssh-tool-required`

**ssh CLI required.** An `ssh://` delivery needs the ssh client and none was found or it is not executable.

- **Fix:** Install OpenSSH or pass `--ssh PATH` (and `--ssh-sha256` to pin it).
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-tool-pin-mismatch)=
### `tool-pin-mismatch`

**Tool differs from its pin.** A pinned tool binary (docker, ssh, kubectl) does not match the given SHA-256, or changed during the operation.

- **Fix:** Check which binary is on PATH; update the `--*-sha256` pin only if the change is expected.
- **Retry-safe:** no


## Artifact delivery outcomes (delivery receipts)

(error-cancelled)=
### `cancelled`

**Cancelled.** The operation was cancelled (interrupt, stop request or cancelled execution).

- **Fix:** Re-run the command when ready; recoverable executions can be resumed with `piceli release resume`.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-digest-mismatch)=
### `digest-mismatch`

**Image does not match the approved digest.** The streamed or stored image's config digest differs from `--approve-digest`.

- **Fix:** Re-inspect the image and approve its actual config digest, or rebuild the image you meant.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-forward-port-in-use)=
### `forward-port-in-use`

**Local forward port in use.** The local port for `kubectl port-forward` is already taken.

- **Fix:** Free the port or pick another one in the `oci://127.0.0.1:PORT/…` target.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-forward-unavailable)=
### `forward-unavailable`

**Port-forward unavailable.** `kubectl port-forward` to the registry did not become ready.

- **Fix:** Check that the registry Deployment is ready and that you may `pods/portforward`; then retry.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-import-cancelled)=
### `import-cancelled`

**Node import cancelled.** The node import was interrupted.

- **Fix:** Re-run the delivery.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-import-failed)=
### `import-failed`

**Node import failed.** `ctr images import` on the node exited with an error.

- **Fix:** Check free disk space and containerd on the node; then retry.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-import-output-limit)=
### `import-output-limit`

**Node import output too large.** `ctr images import` wrote more output than allowed.

- **Fix:** Check the node's containerd; report the problem if it persists.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-import-timed-out)=
### `import-timed-out`

**Node import timed out.** `ctr images import` did not finish within `--timeout`.

- **Fix:** Retry with a larger `--timeout`, or prefer registry delivery for large images.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-invalid-archive)=
### `invalid-archive`

**Invalid image archive.** The `--archive` file is not a valid OCI layout or docker-save tar within the size bounds.

- **Fix:** Recreate it with `docker save` or an OCI build and check it with `piceli artifacts inspect`.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-image-stream)=
### `invalid-image-stream`

**Invalid image stream.** The image streamed by `docker save` could not be parsed or exceeded its bounds.

- **Fix:** Check that the image exists locally and that docker works; then retry.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-node-query-failed)=
### `node-query-failed`

**Node query failed.** Listing or inspecting images on the node (`ctr`) failed.

- **Fix:** Check SSH/docker access to the node and that containerd runs; then retry.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-source-changed)=
### `source-changed`

**Image source changed during delivery.** The image was read twice (plan, then upload) and the second read differed.

- **Fix:** Make sure nothing retags or rebuilds the image during delivery, then retry.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-source-unavailable)=
### `source-unavailable`

**Image source unavailable.** The local image or archive could not be read (for example docker failed to save it).

- **Fix:** Check that the image exists (`docker image ls`) and the daemon is running, then retry.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-timed-out)=
### `timed-out`

**Timed out.** The operation did not finish within `--timeout`.

- **Fix:** Retry with a larger `--timeout`; only missing layers are resent.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-verification-failed)=
### `verification-failed`

**Post-delivery verification failed.** After the transfer, the node or registry did not report the approved image under the expected name.

- **Fix:** Inspect the target (`crictl images` or the registry) and retry the delivery.
- **Retry-safe:** yes


## OCI registry transfers (`piceli artifacts deliver --to oci://…`)

(error-blob-digest-mismatch)=
### `blob-digest-mismatch`

**Uploaded blob digest mismatch.** The registry stored a blob whose digest differs from what was sent.

- **Fix:** Retry; if it persists, the registry or a proxy is altering content.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-blob-source-truncated)=
### `blob-source-truncated`

**Blob source truncated.** A layer ended before its declared size while it was uploaded.

- **Fix:** Make sure nothing changes the image during delivery, then retry.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-cross-origin-location-refused)=
### `cross-origin-location-refused`

**Cross-origin redirect refused.** The registry redirected an upload to another origin.

- **Fix:** Configure the registry to accept uploads on its own address.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-token-realm)=
### `invalid-token-realm`

**Invalid token realm.** The registry's bearer-token challenge names an unusable realm.

- **Fix:** Check the registry's authentication configuration.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-manifest-not-found)=
### `manifest-not-found`

**Manifest not found.** The registry has no manifest for the expected digest after the push.

- **Fix:** Retry the delivery; check that the registry keeps pushed manifests.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-manifest-rejected)=
### `manifest-rejected`

**Manifest rejected.** The registry refused the image manifest.

- **Fix:** Check that the registry accepts OCI or Docker v2 manifests of this type.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-plain-http-refused)=
### `plain-http-refused`

**Plain HTTP refused.** The registry tried to move the transfer to plain HTTP on a non-loopback host.

- **Fix:** Use TLS on the registry.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-registry-digest-mismatch)=
### `registry-digest-mismatch`

**Registry manifest digest mismatch.** The digest the registry reports for the pushed manifest differs from the one computed locally.

- **Fix:** Retry; if it persists, the registry is rewriting manifests and cannot be used.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-registry-error)=
### `registry-error`

**Registry error.** The registry answered with an unexpected HTTP status.

- **Fix:** Check the registry's health and logs, then retry.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-registry-forbidden)=
### `registry-forbidden`

**Registry access forbidden.** The registry answered 403: the credentials may not push to this repository.

- **Fix:** Use credentials with push rights on the repository.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-registry-not-oci-v2)=
### `registry-not-oci-v2`

**Not an OCI distribution registry.** The endpoint does not implement the OCI distribution `/v2/` API.

- **Fix:** Point `--to` at a registry (host, port and scheme).
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-registry-response-too-large)=
### `registry-response-too-large`

**Registry response too large.** A registry response exceeded Piceli's size bound.

- **Fix:** Check that `--to` points at a real registry.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-registry-unauthorized)=
### `registry-unauthorized`

**Registry authentication failed.** The registry answered 401: credentials are missing or wrong.

- **Fix:** Pass `--credentials FILE` with valid credentials.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-registry-unreachable)=
### `registry-unreachable`

**Registry unreachable.** The registry could not be contacted (DNS, TCP or TLS failure).

- **Fix:** Check the address, network and TLS settings (`--ca-file`), then retry.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-upload-rejected)=
### `upload-rejected`

**Upload rejected.** The registry refused a blob upload.

- **Fix:** Check the registry's storage and quota, then retry.
- **Retry-safe:** yes


## Containerized builds (`piceli artifacts build-spec`)

(error-build-failed)=
### `build-failed`

**Build step failed.** A docker build step exited with an error (exit 1; the failing steps are listed, never their output).

- **Fix:** Re-run with `--log FILE` and read the step output there.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-build-timed-out)=
### `build-timed-out`

**Build step timed out.** A docker build step exceeded its time budget (exit 1).

- **Fix:** Retry with a larger `--max-seconds`.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-builder-not-approved)=
### `builder-not-approved`

**Builder not approved.** `--approve-builder` does not match the builder image digest in the spec.

- **Fix:** Review the builder in `build-spec preview` and approve its exact digest.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-context-budget-exceeded)=
### `context-budget-exceeded`

**Build context over budget.** A context has more files or bytes than its budget.

- **Fix:** Narrow the `include` patterns or raise the context budget in the spec.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-context-changed)=
### `context-changed`

**Build context changed.** A context file (or the Dockerfile) changed between scanning and staging.

- **Fix:** Stop editing the sources during the build, then retry.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-context-empty)=
### `context-empty`

**Build context empty.** A context's include patterns matched no files.

- **Fix:** Fix the `include` patterns.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-context-missing)=
### `context-missing`

**Build context missing.** A build context root is not a readable real directory.

- **Fix:** Fix the context path in the spec.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-context-symlink)=
### `context-symlink`

**Symbolic link in build context.** A context include pattern matches a symbolic link.

- **Fix:** Exclude the link or replace it with the real file.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-docker-unavailable)=
### `docker-unavailable`

**Docker unavailable.** The docker CLI, daemon, buildx or context is not usable.

- **Fix:** Check `docker buildx version` and `docker context show`, then retry.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-dockerfile-unpinned)=
### `dockerfile-unpinned`

**Dockerfile not pinned.** A Dockerfile uses an unpinned base image, `COPY --from`, remote `ADD` or `RUN --mount` source, or does not build `FROM` the builder argument.

- **Fix:** Pin every image by digest (`image@sha256:…`) and build `FROM` the builder argument; see docs/containerized_builds.md.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-grant-expired)=
### `grant-expired`

**Build grant expired.** The build ran past `--max-seconds`.

- **Fix:** Retry with a larger `--max-seconds`.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-image-invalid)=
### `image-invalid`

**Built image invalid.** The built image could not be inspected or has an invalid ID.

- **Fix:** Check the build log (`--log`).
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-image-mismatch)=
### `image-mismatch`

**Built image mismatch.** The loaded image differs from the build result or has another platform.

- **Fix:** Check the declared platform and that nothing else loads images concurrently.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-grant)=
### `invalid-grant`

**Invalid build grant.** The approval arguments (`--approve-builder`, `--approve-plan`, `--max-seconds`) are malformed.

- **Fix:** Copy the builder digest and plan hash from `build-spec preview`; use a positive `--max-seconds`.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-inputs)=
### `invalid-inputs`

**Invalid inputs spec or lock.** The `inputs.toml` or inputs lock referenced by the build could not be read or verified.

- **Fix:** Run `piceli inputs verify --spec inputs.toml --lock inputs.lock` to see the problem.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-or-unavailable-build-input)=
### `invalid-or-unavailable-build-input`

**Invalid or unavailable build input.** A build input could not be read or validated (the detail is withheld because it could contain private paths).

- **Fix:** Run `build-spec preview` with the same arguments and check every path it names.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-receipt)=
### `invalid-receipt`

**Invalid build receipt.** The file is not a complete `piceli.build-receipt.v1` receipt.

- **Fix:** Re-run the build to produce a new receipt.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-spec)=
### `invalid-spec`

**Invalid build spec.** The build spec (or a build context in it) is invalid: unknown keys, bad patterns, budgets or paths.

- **Fix:** Run `piceli artifacts build-spec preview --spec build.toml` and fix the spec; see docs/containerized_builds.md.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-tool)=
### `invalid-tool`

**Invalid docker pin.** Only one of `--docker` and `--docker-sha256` was given.

- **Fix:** Pass both, or neither to use docker from PATH.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-network-not-granted)=
### `network-not-granted`

**Network not granted.** The spec declares network access but `--allow-network` was not given.

- **Fix:** Add `--allow-network` if the build may use the network.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-output-invalid)=
### `output-invalid`

**Build output invalid.** The build produced a missing, undeclared, oversized or symlinked output, or the output directory is unusable.

- **Fix:** Make the build produce exactly the declared outputs into a clean `--output-dir`.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-plan-not-approved)=
### `plan-not-approved`

**Build plan not approved.** `--approve-plan` does not match the current build plan hash (the spec or inputs changed).

- **Fix:** Run `build-spec preview` again and approve the new plan hash.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-source-drift)=
### `source-drift`

**Source changed.** A declared source differs from its lock, or changed during the build. Drift is currently checked over the whole repository, not only the build context.

- **Fix:** Commit or stash the changes and record a new lock with `piceli inputs record`.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-source-identity)=
### `source-identity`

**Source identity unavailable.** A declared source could not be identified with git (not a work tree, git failed).

- **Fix:** Run `piceli inputs record --spec inputs.toml` to see which source fails.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-spec-unreadable)=
### `spec-unreadable`

**Build spec unreadable.** `--spec` could not be read.

- **Fix:** Check the path and its permissions.
- **Retry-safe:** no


## Kubernetes API access (release plan/apply, discovery)

(error-api-unavailable)=
### `api-unavailable`

**Kubernetes API unavailable.** The API server answered 429 or 5xx, or an API group could not be discovered.

- **Fix:** Wait for the API server to recover, then retry.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-conflict)=
### `conflict`

**Kubernetes write conflict.** The API server answered 409: the object changed since it was observed.

- **Fix:** Run `piceli release plan` again and approve the new plan hash.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-deadline-exceeded)=
### `deadline-exceeded`

**Deadline exceeded.** A request or the whole execution ran past its time limit.

- **Fix:** Retry; for an interrupted apply use `piceli release resume`, or raise `[execution] max_seconds`.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-identity-mismatch)=
### `identity-mismatch`

**Object identity mismatch.** The API server returned an object whose kind, name or namespace differs from the request.

- **Fix:** Plan again; if it persists, report it.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-force)=
### `invalid-force`

**Invalid force flag.** A create was requested with force ownership, which is never allowed.

- **Fix:** This is an internal contract violation; report it.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-page)=
### `invalid-page`

**Invalid discovery page.** The API server returned an inconsistent list page.

- **Fix:** Plan again; if it persists, report the API server version.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-invalid-request)=
### `invalid-request`

**Kubernetes rejected the object.** The API server answered 422: the manifest is invalid for this cluster.

- **Fix:** Fix the composition (field names, API versions); admission dry-run in `plan` shows the object.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-write-response)=
### `invalid-write-response`

**Invalid write response.** The API server's answer to a write did not confirm the requested object and ownership.

- **Fix:** Inspect the object with a read-only tool; when it matches the release, run `piceli release resume --spec release.toml`, otherwise plan again.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-limit-exceeded)=
### `limit-exceeded`

**Discovery limit exceeded.** Discovery found more objects or bytes than `[discovery]` allows.

- **Fix:** Raise the `[discovery]` limits in the spec, then plan again.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-missing-precondition)=
### `missing-precondition`

**Missing write precondition.** An update was requested without the object's UID and resourceVersion.

- **Fix:** This is an internal contract violation; report it.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-not-found)=
### `not-found`

**Kubernetes object not found.** The API server answered 404.

- **Fix:** Run `piceli release plan` again and approve the new plan hash.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-not-retained)=
### `not-retained`

**Object is not retained.** A metadata-only adoption was requested for a kind that is not retained (only PVCs and Secrets are).

- **Fix:** Run `piceli release plan` again and approve the new plan hash.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-provider-error)=
### `provider-error`

**Provider error.** The Kubernetes provider failed in an unclassified way during discovery.

- **Fix:** Plan again; if it persists, report it.
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-rbac-denied)=
### `rbac-denied`

**Kubernetes access denied.** The API server answered 401 or 403 for a request the plan or apply needs.

- **Fix:** Grant the identity in the spec's kubeconfig the needed verbs in the namespace, then plan again.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-request-byte-limit)=
### `request-byte-limit`

**Request too large.** An object is larger than Piceli's request bound.

- **Fix:** Reduce the object's size (for example move data out of a ConfigMap).
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-response-byte-limit)=
### `response-byte-limit`

**Response too large.** An API response exceeded Piceli's response bound.

- **Fix:** Reduce the objects' size; if a write was in flight, use `piceli release resume`.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-scope-mismatch)=
### `scope-mismatch`

**Scope mismatch.** A namespaced object was declared without the target namespace, or a cluster-scoped one with a namespace.

- **Fix:** Fix the object's namespace in the composition.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-server-target-identity-mismatch)=
### `server-target-identity-mismatch`

**Cluster identity mismatch.** The cluster or namespace UID differs from the one pinned in the spec, or the namespace is being deleted.

- **Fix:** Check that the kubeconfig and context point at the intended cluster; update `cluster_uid`/`namespace_uid` only if the cluster was rebuilt.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-takeover-conflict)=
### `takeover-conflict`

**Takeover conflict.** Adopting an object by takeover kept conflicting with another field manager.

- **Fix:** Stop the other writer (controller, script) or plan the adoption again.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-target-mismatch)=
### `target-mismatch`

**Target mismatch.** A request named a cluster or namespace other than the provider's configured target.

- **Fix:** Check `[target]` in the spec; plan again.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-transport-error)=
### `transport-error`

**Kubernetes transport error.** The connection to the API server failed.

- **Fix:** Check network access to the cluster, then retry (a write may be ambiguous: use `release resume`).
- **Retry-safe:** yes

(error-undiscovered-api)=
### `undiscovered-api`

**API not discovered.** A list request used an API resource that discovery did not return.

- **Fix:** Check that the CRD or API group is installed; plan again.
- **Retry-safe:** no


## Plan execution preconditions (release apply/resume/rollback)

(error-absence-precondition-failed)=
### `absence-precondition-failed`

**Object appeared.** The plan creates an object that now exists (someone created it after planning).

- **Fix:** Run `piceli release plan` again and approve the new plan hash. Add `--adopt Kind/name` if the release should take it over.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-ambiguous-content-blocked)=
### `ambiguous-content-blocked`

**Ambiguous write content differs.** A previous write's result is unknown and the live content differs from the plan.

- **Fix:** Inspect the object with a read-only tool; when it matches the release, run `piceli release resume --spec release.toml`, otherwise plan again.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-ambiguous-delete-blocked)=
### `ambiguous-delete-blocked`

**Ambiguous delete blocked.** A previous delete's result is unknown and the object still exists.

- **Fix:** Inspect the object with a read-only tool; when it matches the release, run `piceli release resume --spec release.toml`, otherwise plan again.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-ambiguous-write-blocked)=
### `ambiguous-write-blocked`

**Ambiguous write blocked.** A previous write's result is unknown and the live object does not prove it was ours.

- **Fix:** Inspect the object with a read-only tool; when it matches the release, run `piceli release resume --spec release.toml`, otherwise plan again.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-applied-resource-drift)=
### `applied-resource-drift`

**Applied object drifted.** An object changed after Piceli applied it (another writer is active).

- **Fix:** Stop the other writer, then plan again.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-authorization-expired)=
### `authorization-expired`

**Authorization expired.** The approved plan's authorization expired before the execution finished.

- **Fix:** Run `piceli release plan` again and approve the new plan hash.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-compensation-already-started)=
### `compensation-already-started`

**Compensation already started.** The execution is being compensated (undone) and cannot continue forward.

- **Fix:** Run `piceli release plan` again and approve the new plan hash.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-deleted-resource-reappeared)=
### `deleted-resource-reappeared`

**Deleted object reappeared.** An object the execution deleted exists again.

- **Fix:** Find the controller or script that recreates it, then plan again.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-field-owner-precondition-failed)=
### `field-owner-precondition-failed`

**Field owners changed.** The set of field managers on the object changed since planning.

- **Fix:** Run `piceli release plan` again and approve the new plan hash.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-generation-precondition-failed)=
### `generation-precondition-failed`

**Object generation changed.** The object's spec changed since planning.

- **Fix:** Run `piceli release plan` again and approve the new plan hash.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-invalid-field-ownership-evidence)=
### `invalid-field-ownership-evidence`

**Invalid field-ownership evidence.** The object's managedFields could not be read.

- **Fix:** Plan again; if it persists, report the API server version.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-no-op-content-mismatch)=
### `no-op-content-mismatch`

**No-op object drifted.** An object planned as unchanged no longer contains the declared content.

- **Fix:** Run `piceli release plan` again and approve the new plan hash.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-operation-identity-mismatch)=
### `operation-identity-mismatch`

**Operation identity mismatch.** The object carries another execution's operation annotation.

- **Fix:** Make sure only one apply runs at a time, then plan again.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-ownership-precondition-failed)=
### `ownership-precondition-failed`

**Ownership changed.** The object is not owned by this release (or another owner claimed it) and the plan does not adopt it.

- **Fix:** Run `piceli release plan` again and approve the new plan hash. Add `--adopt Kind/name` to take it over explicitly.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-readiness-timeout)=
### `readiness-timeout`

**Readiness timeout.** An applied object did not become ready within `[execution] readiness_seconds`.

- **Fix:** Check the workload (`kubectl describe`, logs); fix it and plan again, or `piceli release rollback previous`.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-readiness-unsupported)=
### `readiness-unsupported`

**Readiness unsupported.** Piceli cannot evaluate readiness for this kind.

- **Fix:** Report the kind; meanwhile verify it by hand.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-recreated-object)=
### `recreated-object`

**Object was recreated.** The object has another UID than planned: someone deleted and recreated it.

- **Fix:** Run `piceli release plan` again and approve the new plan hash.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-resource-content-precondition-failed)=
### `resource-content-precondition-failed`

**Object content changed.** The object's content changed since planning.

- **Fix:** Run `piceli release plan` again and approve the new plan hash.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-retained-adoption-precondition-failed)=
### `retained-adoption-precondition-failed`

**Not a retained object.** A metadata-only adoption was planned for an object that is not retained.

- **Fix:** Run `piceli release plan` again and approve the new plan hash.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-retained-content-precondition-failed)=
### `retained-content-precondition-failed`

**Retained object content differs.** A retained object's live content differs from the declared content, so it cannot be adopted metadata-only.

- **Fix:** Make the declaration match the live object, then plan again.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-retained-resource)=
### `retained-resource`

**Retained object not deleted.** The plan would delete a retained object (PersistentVolumeClaim or Secret); Piceli never deletes retained data.

- **Fix:** Delete it yourself after a backup if that is intended.
- **Retry-safe:** no

(error-uid-version-precondition-failed)=
### `uid-version-precondition-failed`

**Object changed since planning.** The object's UID or resourceVersion differs from the planned one.

- **Fix:** Run `piceli release plan` again and approve the new plan hash.
- **Retry-safe:** no
